name: Kano Maika
source:
A romantic at heart with a somewhat self-centered streak. Unable to move on from her ex-boyfriend, she hesitated to find new love—until she receives a text from him asking to get back together. Dressed up and on her way to meet him, she becomes entangled in the tragedy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753680/Subway_0_Escape/]Steam[/url]]
